requirements.text: Provide real-time notifications for transactions, important account events, and budget thresholds.
Deliver notifications via customizable push notifications.
Implement enhanced security features including biometric authentication options (fingerprint and facial recognition).
Allow customers to freeze and unfreeze debit and credit cards instantly.
Provide automated monthly spending breakdowns categorized by merchant type.
Incorporate trend analysis for spending, showing changes over time.
Allow customers to set personalized monthly budgets with alerts for approaching limits.
Create a dedicated 'Insights' section in the app for navigating spending breakdowns and trends.
Provide a streamlined process for requesting overdraft increases with an instant decision feature.
Implement a user-friendly 'Loans' section for applying for personal loans.
Include a calculator for estimated monthly repayments for loans.
Ensure all lending features comply with responsible lending regulations.
Provide a unified view of all accounts including current accounts, savings accounts, and credit card balances.
Display recognizable icons and color-coded indicators for account statuses.
Allow customers to filter transactions by date range, category, or type.
Include visual representations of overall financial health through graphs or charts.
Ensure the app is accessible and responsive across mobile and tablet devices.
Align all features with regulations like PSD2 and GDPR.
